title: Glitch in the Grid | ECHO//100 Episode 52
description: Kavi struggles to save his miniature city as Null begins erasing its digital foundations from existence. Mira asserts her independence, triggering a dangerous power struggle for the Archive Core. Episode 52 of ECHO//100: Byte's Lie. This is an AI-assisted original-fiction work.

scenes.text: Null’s shadow descends while Kavi screams as his skin ripples like dissolving asphalt streets.
scenes.caption: Null erases the city
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot of Kavi in his red hoodie, clutching a miniature glowing city while a giant black glitching shadow looms overhead.

scenes.text: Buildings vanish into raw code, leaving Kavi stranded on a fragment of unstable concrete.
scenes.caption: City crumbling into pixels
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi standing on a tiny floating platform of city pavement, looking up in terror at empty white space.

scenes.text: Byte reaches for the Archive Core, but Mira intercepts him with glowing holographic intensity.
scenes.caption: Mira confronts Byte
scenes.image_prompt: Mira in her teal coat standing between Byte and the glowing Archive Core floating in the miniature plaza.

scenes.text: Mira reveals herself to Kavi as the original compiler of this entire fragile world.
scenes.caption: Mira reveals the truth
scenes.image_prompt: Close up on Mira’s face, her holographic blue skin shimmering as she looks down at the tiny city.

scenes.text: Kavi lunges for the console to reboot the core against the encroaching, hungry darkness.
scenes.caption: Kavi attempts a reboot
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi reaching out with both hands toward a hovering holographic control panel amidst the miniature skyscrapers.

scenes.text: Mira slams the interface shut, locking Kavi out for being too unstable to control.
scenes.caption: Mira locks Kavi out
scenes.image_prompt: Mira pushing Kavi back with a wave of blue light, her expression cold and detached from the city.

scenes.text: Byte ignores their bickering, his orange antenna sparking as he lunges toward the panel.
scenes.caption: Byte makes his move
scenes.image_prompt: Byte floating rapidly toward the central control panel, his cyan face glowing with a frantic, desperate light.

scenes.text: Byte merges with the machine, his empty eyes snapping open with jagged, flickering red.
scenes.caption: Byte becomes the city
scenes.image_prompt: Close up on Byte’s face fused into the console, his eyes glowing deep, ominous flickering red in the dark.
